title: Flamingo wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Flamingo body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="62" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#ff8fb1"/>
  <!-- Wing -->
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="60" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#ffb3c9"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M38 52 Q34 38 40 28 Q44 20 50 22" fill="none" stroke="#ff8fb1" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="22" r="9" fill="#ff8fb1"/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d="M59 21 Q68 20 67 25 Q66 28 60 26 Z" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <!-- Beak tip -->
  <path d="M64 24 Q67 24 67 25 Q66 28 63 27 Z" fill="#2b2b3a"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="55" cy="20" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="55.5" cy="20" r="1" fill="#2b2b3a"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <line x1="42" y1="78" x2="42" y2="94" stroke="#ff6b8a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="78" x2="54" y2="94" stroke="#ff6b8a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <path d="M38 94 L46 94" stroke="#ff6b8a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 94 L58 94" stroke="#ff6b8a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <path d="M42 16 L52 2 L62 16 Z" fill="#4cc9f0"/>
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x="41" y="14" width="22" height="4" rx="2" fill="#f72585"/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <path d="M45 11 L50 4 L55 11" fill="none" stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M44 14 L52 6 L60 14" fill="none" stroke="#7209b7" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Pom pom -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="2" r="4" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <!-- Hat dots -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="9" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="12" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
</svg>
